storageDecision: ADR-0004 foundation plus Workspace 003 work location, Knowledge 003 immutable handoffs and Workspace 004 permanent protected claims; isolated storage evidence is not handler or guard acceptance. Workspace 005 owner-authorised session persistence and private authentication clock/audit; no public auth handler acceptance. Workspace 007 adds immutable project origin and private explicit create authority/audit; separate 008 adds permanent minimal project-operation snapshots. Tested disposable storage/handlers do not authorise a development upgrade or D-07 transport acceptance. SP-03 owner selected immutable Task.created_at and permanent original createTask result retention with current access checks; additive 009 and Task handlers now have bounded local evidence in FEAT-SP03-01. Logical schema checks alone remain distinct from permission/handler verification. SP-04 P03A2 records owner-selected separate edit authority, enabled new-assignee eligibility and indefinite original Task200/Blocker201 retention with current read/action checks. ADR-0028 mechanics are Proposed; this metadata/constraint refinement adds no entity/field/relationship and no physical migration or handler. SP-05 selected separate actions and nullable observed Sprint lifecycle timestamps under FEAT-SP05-01;011/producers need actual evidence.

entities.name: Task
constraints: location_kind = backlog: null Sprint reference, no allocated association; any task state allowed
location_kind = sprint: same-project reference to an allocated association in Planned/Active Sprint
location_kind = completed: Done task with same-project completed association and Completed Sprint
Location references are deferred foreign keys; final state checked across task, allocation and Sprint writes
Completed associations remain immutable independently of current task location
created_at is immutable server-recorded creation time; Task responses and original createTask outcomes preserve the same UTC millisecond timestamp; no fabricated legacy backfill
SP-04 selected policy: new content edits require separately provisioned edit authority and current Backlog placement; creator/create-only backlog-author/role labels imply no edit action

SP-04 selected policy: new non-null assignee must be enabled and a current same-project member; committed replay acknowledges history without restoring assignment or rechecking historical target eligibility

entities.name: Execution
constraints: Actual queries/steps/selected source provenance are mandatory producing records; persistence failure cannot be represented as missing optional telemetry
Duration/usage are measured with nonnegative value, unavailable without invented value, or not_performed for unexecuted activities
Inspection projections filter current source/query/validation disclosure separately from immutable recorded history; no raw private reasoning

entities.name: IdempotencyRecord
constraints: SP-04 owner-selected indefinite original editTask/setTaskState/setAssignee200 Task (including title/description) and recordBlocker201 Blocker; consumed actor/operation/key/hash retained without automatic expiry or key recycling

Original results are immutable historical acknowledgements; current Task/project read and exact action authority precede replay; current-state reads are separate; preserve existing operation and protected-handoff branches

entities.name: CapabilityGrant
constraints: Proposed ADR-0028 maps task-edit/task-state/task-assign/task-blocker to explicit project-scoped grants; private audited operator only issues/revives, runtime may invalidate on member removal; rejoin restores none

entities.name: HandoffManifest
constraints: Complete manifest plus exact serialized manifest bytes/digest and durable receipt commit atomically in Knowledge; no mutable/incomplete ready row
Evidence is a discriminated document-or-operational set with per-source policy/lifecycle or entity/observation revision/time/digest
Immutable manifest stores identities/digests and scope references, never provider payload/source content or private reasoning
Knowledge migration 003 stores exact bytes and complete JSON evidence atomically with generated SHA-256 and immutable receipt; run/actor/project reference owned execution

entities.name: ProtectedHandoffClaim
constraints: Map operation=protected_handoff to owned idempotency storage; only fresh durably acknowledged claim can enter guard
No expiry/deletion into send eligibility; unknown/consumed/aborted claims never permit replay

Workspace migration 004 reserves protected_handoff in idempotency_record with immutable fence/process, infinity expiry and append-only outcomes; active process/guard/transport enforcement remains unimplemented
The pending idempotency state means the claim identity is consumed from insertion, not eligible for resend; only a fresh known committed insertion returns a new fence

entities.name: ExecutionStep
constraints: Mandatory recorded stage/query/provenance separate from optional metric availability; no raw tool payload/private reasoning

entities.name: StepSource
constraints: Reference one exact per-run Provenance locator; same source may participate in multiple steps
Visible rank is densely derived after current access filtering, not persisted as unrestricted global rank

entities.name: DocumentCommandPrecondition
constraints: Opaque unpredictable token reference; bind exact command scope and private current revision
No permission grant; current authority and revision checked under guarded mutation
Consume with committed mutation/audit/idempotency; invalid/revoked/stale/unknown token never becomes fresh by cleanup; only original same-key receipt may replay
Additive mapping and retention/cleanup remain implementation work; no cross-service writes

entities.name: ProtectedHandoffOutcome
constraints: Composite foreign key binds the exact actor/protected_handoff/identity/fence; append-only observation does not prove external delivery or permit replay

entities.name: AuthAccount
constraints: Exact case-sensitive pre-provisioned username; runtime has no account/credential UPDATE
Manual disable invalidates existing sessions; no automatic failed-attempt lockout

entities.name: SessionToken
constraints: Unique SHA-256 digest only; immutable token identity/absolute deadline
Existing Session effective expiry is bounded by this immutable absolute cap

entities.name: AuthClockState
constraints: Initially unhealthy; observed regression latches fault
Runtime cannot clear fault; operator recovery revokes all old sessions with minimum audit atomically
Mitigation cannot establish elapsed time in unobserved intervals

entities.name: AuthenticationAudit
constraints: Append-only private authentication events; no project-audit visibility implied
Never raw password/token/cookie, credential hash or token digest

invariants: No cross-service database writes/joins
Project membership AND current document scope govern source access
Membership removal invalidates read grants; rejoin creates no restricted grant
At most one Active Sprint per project; a task has at most one Planned/Active allocation
Task blocked state derives from highest committed blocker sequence
Version/passage evidence is immutable
Product versions are Current/Superseded/Archived; revision atomically supersedes old Current and inserts new Current
Old jobs cannot revive unavailable/tombstoned content
No answer cache or permission-decision cache in MVP
Workspace allocates document identity; registered policy is not content availability
Restricted creation adds a revocable author read grant; authorship never bypasses current access
Unfinished Backlog returns become To Do atomically with allocation, task revision and audit; completed allocation history is immutable
Complete immutable handoff manifests commit outside guard; guarded exact evidence/revision/payload matching precedes any send
A mismatch sends zero bytes and releases guard before a fresh bounded preparation; prepared records prove no send; consumed handoff IDs cannot be reused
Current task location is persisted explicitly, never inferred from historical completed associations or Done alone
Project backlog_revision changes atomically on entry/exit/reposition within Backlog, not merely title/state/blocker changes
Reorder expected_revision equals listTasks backlog_revision and task_ids is a complete Backlog permutation; reject partial/stale submissions
Frozen payload digest hashes exact outbound UTF-8 bytes; manifest digest hashes exact immutable manifest bytes, not a reserialized object
Workspace verifies committed Knowledge record before one-use claim; purpose/run/attempt/actor/project/destination and complete mixed evidence must match before any protected byte
Trace/summary source locators bind retrieval step and visible dense rank; denied source identities and dependent query/validation data are omitted without hidden counts
Optional missing metrics are explicitly unavailable, never fabricated zero; not_performed identifies an activity that never executed
SP-04 business changes, minimum audit and immutable original outcomes co-commit; known rollback differs from unknown acknowledgement requiring same-key/input reconciliation

SP-04 proposed no-op edits/state/assignment retain original Task without fake change audit/revision bump; distinct blocker operations append and advance revision; current read/action checks still apply
SP-05 Could: independent private sprint-edit and sprint-deallocate; no role/create/allocate inference; current authority before immutable original-result replay
editSprint new keys require Planned and Sprint revision; merge partial dates before strict validation; no-op acknowledges without revision/change audit

removeAllocation new keys allow only current todo/in_progress in Planned/Active; reject Done and Completed to preserve completed-work attribution and future Sprint metrics; X-Expected-Revision is Sprint revision

Removal atomically marks Returned, clears current Sprint, appends To Do after numeric MAX(position), advances allocation/Task/Sprint revisions and Backlog generation, preserves assignee/blockers/history and co-commits source/prior/result audit with immutable typed 200 Sprint receipt
